baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collective says 'poet' and then waits over him for the uncertain turns of al-manun.
baseline_models.mechanism: A circulating genre-label replaces direct engagement, while watchful expectancy delegates the desired defeat to time as a power that diminishes and cuts an extension.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public talk supplies the social vehicle by which the accusation can keep moving.
The literal poet and poetry branch supplies the classificatory label imposed on the addressee.
Watchful waiting supplies the group's chosen mode of action instead of immediate refutation.
Uncertain turns of time and death supply the contingency on which their strategy depends.
Cutting and diminishing an extension supplies death as attritional interruption rather than argumentative victory.

changed_reading.before: They insult him as a poet and hope that he dies.
changed_reading.after: They coordinate a public label and outsource suppression to attritional time, hoping interruption will accomplish what rebuttal has not.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative report and the noun rayb place uncertainty both inside their saying and inside the fate they await.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying can function as a supposition rather than settled knowledge; disturbance is then projected away from the speakers and onto a hoped-for loss of the target's sustaining force.

activation_trace.role: Saying with the force of supposing, especially in a question, makes the accusation epistemically provisional.
Disturbing doubt supplies the instability that the speakers displace onto the expected event.
The loss of an inner sustaining strength gives their uncertain forecast a gradual depletion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They confidently diagnose the speaker and forecast his end.
changed_reading.after: Their own syntax preserves the diagnosis as a disturbed supposition, then projects that disturbance into a forecast that his sustaining force will fail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate 'poet' is attached to a person and followed by a collective willingness to let time work on him.
baseline_models.mechanism: False attribution becomes a portable identifying mark, almost a skin-adjacent garment; repeated public use can fasten the category to the person while the speakers wait for the stigma to do causal work.

activation_trace.role: False saying or attribution supplies the act of assigning an identity that need not describe its target.
An identifying mark or emblem supplies the public badge into which 'poet' can be converted.
An inner garment touching the body supplies the image of a label made to adhere closely to the person.
Watchful expectancy gives the imposed mark time to acquire social effects.

changed_reading.after: 'Poet' is an imposed social badge: the group names, fastens, and waits for the naming to isolate its bearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speakers hold back around him, waiting for an outcome that they fear or desire not to miss.
baseline_models.mechanism: The commodity-waiting branch of tarabbus and the measured-weight branch of mann make the posture resemble a speculative hold: they preserve a hostile position until his viability loses measure or is cut off.

activation_trace.role: Holding goods while waiting on price supplies the material analogy of maintaining a position for a later payoff.
A sought need feared to be missed supplies the anticipated payoff that keeps the group waiting.
A measured weight supplies valuation and finite measure to the life or force on which they speculate.
Diminution toward cutoff supplies the hoped-for downward movement of that finite measure.

changed_reading.before: They passively wait for a random calamity.
changed_reading.after: They maintain a hostile speculative position, treating delay as an investment in his measurable depletion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Soothsayer, reason-covered madman, poet, and fabricator invoke incompatible causal accounts. Their adjacency makes 'poet' one replaceable container in an accusation generator; the demand for a matching truthful discourse then turns classification into a production test.

activation_trace.role: False attribution supplies the common operation beneath the changing predicates.
The poet branch supplies one concrete label in the neighboring series.
A diviner claiming hidden reports supplies a high-access explanation incompatible with mere poetic composition.
Covering of reason supplies a low-agency explanation incompatible with controlled hidden knowledge.
Fabricated attribution supplies the next interchangeable explanation in the sequence.
Renewed report or discourse supplies the object opponents are challenged to produce.
Likeness supplies the comparison test that a genuine genre diagnosis should make answerable.
Truthful speech supplies the condition that exposes whether the labels have explanatory force.

structural_cues: 52:29-34 rejects soothsayer and madman, records poet and fabricator, then requests like speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies adjacent incompatible labels and a likeness challenge; I infer that replaceability, not diagnosis, is the stable mechanism. A live alternative is that separate subgroups voiced separate claims without experiencing them as inconsistent.

changed_reading.after: 'Poet' is a disposable mask in a serial refusal mechanism, retained only until another label can postpone the production test.

context_deltas.mechanism: The charge that he fabricated the discourse is followed by creation questions whose root inventory joins measuring, originating, and fabricating speech. The sequence turns a literary authorship accusation back on its speakers: they classify his making while unable to account for their own making or the world's.

activation_trace.role: False saying or attribution supplies the act of assigning fabricated authorship to the speaker.
Poetry and poet supply the literary-making category through which they explain the discourse.
The repeated false-attribution branch makes fabricated speech explicit immediately after the focus.
Measuring and estimating a thing supply the design operation implicit in any claim of crafted authorship.
Fabricating lies or speech supplies a direct lexical bridge from their accusation to the creation question.
Originating creation supplies the larger authorship domain against which their literary explanation is tested.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies the epistemic standard their account fails to meet.

structural_cues: 52:33 alleges fabricated speech; 52:35-36 immediately asks whether the speakers are uncaused, self-creators, or creators of the heavens and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies fabrication, measurement, origination, and failed certainty; I infer that the text scales their authorship accusation until its own causal assumptions collapse. A live alternative is that the creation questions concern theology independently of the poet/fabricator labels.

changed_reading.before: 'Poet' means that a human author crafted this discourse.
changed_reading.after: The label initiates an authorship test that rebounds: their theory of his making cannot survive questions about who made them, what they can make, and what they actually know.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their unilateral 'we await him' is first mirrored by 'wait, I am with you among the waiters' and later inverted into being left until they meet their own day. The active watchers become the watched parties carried toward an appointment.

activation_trace.role: Watchful expectancy supplies the one-sided temporal posture claimed by the group.
Uncertain turns of time supply the event they imagine observing from outside.
Cutoff supplies the endpoint they assign exclusively to him.
Repeated watchful waiting admits the speaker into the same temporal field and removes their monopoly on delay.
Leaving something supplies the passive exposure into which the former watchers are placed.
What a person meets of good or harm supplies an encounter they cannot remain outside.
The day's severe occurrence supplies an appointment that replaces their vague desired contingency.

structural_cues: 52:31 repeats the focus verb with reversed participation; 52:45 changes the watchers into people left until their own meeting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies exact verbal repetition, shared waiting, and a later appointed meeting; I infer a subject-object reversal in temporal agency. A live alternative is that the imperative merely threatens them without redefining the earlier wait.

changed_reading.before: They alone occupy the future and watch for his end.
changed_reading.after: The future becomes reciprocal and then turns them into its objects: they can wait, but they cannot stand outside the appointment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus qawl branch already permits saying to work like supposition in a question. The continuing am-chain tests command, self-control, certainty, and access to the unseen, so 'poet' becomes one hypothesis under cross-examination rather than a narrator-endorsed report.

activation_trace.role: Interrogative saying with the force of supposing supplies the grammatical opening for a tested hypothesis.
Disturbing doubt supplies the epistemic condition exposed by the test.
Deliberation and management of judgment supply the alleged reasoning process placed under question.
Forbearance and self-command supply the faculty whose supposed authority is tested against their excess.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies the standard the speakers fail to reach.
The unseen as doubt supplies the unresolved domain about which their chain of claims pretends competence.

structural_cues: The particle am recurs from 52:30 through 52:43, converting accusations and authority claims into a sustained question series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies the qawl-supposition branch and a repeated interrogative series; I infer that the series audits the generators of the claim. A live alternative is that am simply enumerates denials and does not activate the special suppositional grammar.

changed_reading.before: The verse straightforwardly reports what they say.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages their saying as a provisional hypothesis inside a cross-examination whose later questions expose its failed epistemic supports.

context_deltas.mechanism: To forecast the target's cutoff is to speak as if one possesses the stores, listening route, compelling warrant, unseen information, and ledger that govern outcomes. The later questions expose the malicious wish as an unauthorized jurisdictional claim.

activation_trace.role: Arrogating judgment over another supplies the hidden authority claim inside their forecast.
The uncertain turns of death and time supply the future domain they presume to assign.
Cutoff supplies the judgment they pronounce over the other person's span.
Secured possession supplies the queried resource base for any claim to control outcomes.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the queried access channel to higher information.
A compelling proof supplies the absent warrant that would authorize their prediction.
What is hidden from sight supplies the inaccessible temporal knowledge their forecast assumes.
Writing that fixes a judgment or decree supplies the ledger-like authority they act as though they possess.

structural_cues: 52:37-41 asks in sequence about treasuries, a listening ascent and proof, then possession of the unseen and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies questions about possession, access, warrant, unseen knowledge, and writing; I infer that predicting al-manun covertly claims jurisdiction over another's future. A live alternative is that their words express only a wish and make no sincere knowledge claim.

changed_reading.before: They voice a hostile expectation about death.
changed_reading.after: They issue an unauthorized sentence over a future they neither possess, hear, prove, see, nor write.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby chain of wage, binding liability, and burden gives the focus's price-waiting and measured-weight branches an economic field. Their tarabbus can be carried as a hostile short position, while the question about payment denies that any actual fee or debt caused it.

activation_trace.role: Withholding goods while waiting on price supplies the speculative structure of their delay.
A desired need feared to be missed supplies the hoped-for payoff.
Measured weight supplies the finite valuation imagined to be declining.
Wage or compensation supplies the explicit price term in the surrounding challenge.
Binding financial liability supplies the debt relation the verse explicitly questions.
A burdensome load supplies the cost that would explain resistance if it actually existed.

structural_cues: 52:40 compresses requested wage, liability, and burden into one causal question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies commodity waiting, measure, wage, debt, and burden; I infer a speculative analogy for their temporal hostility. A live alternative is that the economic vocabulary remains local to 52:40 and should not govern the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: They merely wait for an external mishap.
changed_reading.after: They hold a hostile position for a decline they expect to profit from, even though the context denies any real charge that would motivate the grievance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their watchful delay is activated as a low-motion scheme: they intend an outcome but outsource the hard action to time. The later plot verse makes intention and device explicit, turns the plotters into its objects, and then denies their scheme sufficiency or aid.

activation_trace.role: Watchful waiting supplies the quiet operational form of the intended scheme.
Uncertain turns of time and death supply the external instrument on which the scheme relies.
Cutoff supplies the desired result of their otherwise indirect operation.
Will and intention supply the purposive arrow that the focus leaves implicit.
Device and stratagem supply the named mechanism, while the two occurrences reverse agent and patient.
Sufficiency supplies what their scheme is explicitly denied when its appointed test arrives.
The returning stratagem branch carries the same device forward to its failure.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the external support their temporal scheme also lacks.

structural_cues: 52:42 shifts from 'they intend a scheme' to 'they are the schemed-against'; 52:46 returns to their scheme and denies it efficacy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies waiting, intended stratagem, passive reversal, insufficiency, and absent aid; I infer that the focus wait is the scheme's patient form. A live alternative is that waiting for death and the later plot are separate hostile acts.

changed_reading.before: They wait passively for time to solve their problem.
changed_reading.after: Their passivity is itself a scheme that recruits time as an instrument, but the scheme reverses its object and proves unable to secure them.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later scene shows direct sight of a detached falling sky-piece followed by the harmless label 'piled cloud.' The syntactic echo turns 'poet' into the same defensive algorithm: perceive a threatening sign, rename it as a familiar category, and let the category override the indication.

False attribution supplies the repeated act of replacing what is seen with a safer account.

structural_cues: Both 52:30 and 52:44 use 'they say' to place a compact noun-label after a threatening encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies direct sight, falling matter, and immediate renaming, plus the focus's parallel speech frame; I infer one classification-defense algorithm across the scenes. A live alternative is that cloud-renaming is a separate eschatological denial with no intended analogy to 'poet.'

changed_reading.before: 'Poet' is a mistaken opinion about a person.
changed_reading.after: 'Poet' is an evidence-management reflex: as with 'piled cloud,' naming converts a threatening indication into a familiar object that can be ignored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close replaces hostile watchfulness for random cutoff with restrained endurance under corrective judgment and protective sight, then schedules praise at rising, night, and the stars' retreat. Their death-clock is answered by a governed, recurrent practice-clock.

The end and passing aftermath of a thing supplies a recurrent boundary rather than final extinction.
The visible stars supply the celestial markers by which the recurring practice-clock is read.

structural_cues: 52:48-49 orders patience, protective sight, praise at rising, night practice, and the retreat of stars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies two forms of delay and an explicitly timed closing practice; I infer competing temporal disciplines, hostile attrition versus protected recurrence. A live alternative is that the final worship schedule consoles the speaker without answering the opponents' waiting posture.

changed_reading.before: The opponents control the interval by waiting for his clock to run out.
changed_reading.after: Their indefinite death-watch is countered by disciplined recurrent time in which the speaker remains protected, acts, and repeatedly renews orientation.

changed_reading.before: They merely predict that time will end his life.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they speak like unauthorized supervisors weighing and inscribing another person's allotted endpoint.

strongest_changes: The adjacent soothsayer, madman, poet, and fabricator labels make 'poet' a replaceable refusal device, while the likeness challenge converts classification into a production test.
The fabrication charge expands into creation questions, turning their theory of his authorship back on their inability to account for their own origin or authority.
Exact repetition of tarabbus and the later appointed meeting turn unilateral spectators into participants and finally objects of time.
The intended scheme is named, passively reversed, and denied sufficiency, revealing hostile waiting as an indirect plot that recruits time.
52:44's visible falling piece renamed 'piled cloud' exposes 'poet' as an evidence-management category rather than a settled diagnosis.
The am-chain, unseen, listening, proof, and writing cues recast their forecast as an interrogative hypothesis and unauthorized sentence over another's future.
summary.what_was_special: The narrow context repeatedly reuses the focus's mechanisms with changed agency: qawl moves among report, supposition, false attribution, and arrogated judgment; tarabbus becomes reciprocal and then an appointment; labeling becomes a production test and a renaming reflex; passive waiting becomes an explicit scheme. The readings remain coexisting rather than collapsing into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The qawl-as-supposition reading may be a live grammatical echo rather than the intended syntax of this exact clause.
The fabrication-to-creation scale shift is structurally tight but may join two distinct argumentative steps rather than one authorship mechanism.
The economic, measured-ledger, and non-dominant ق ل ل readings are packet-licensed analogies and must not be rendered as lexical translations.
The parallel between 'poet' and 'piled cloud' may encode one renaming reflex, but the two scenes can also stand as separate denials.
Treating watchful waiting as the patient form of kayd is abductive; the context names the scheme later but does not explicitly equate the two.
